# Senior Data Engineer (Azure and Databricks)

Company: Nordlys Analytics A/S, Copenhagen (hybrid, two days a week in the office)

Nordlys Analytics is a fictional consultancy that builds data platforms for Nordic retailers. We value curiosity, ownership and plain-spoken teamwork.

## About the role
You will design and run cloud data pipelines for our customers and lead a small team of engineers. You work directly with business stakeholders to turn requirements into reliable data products.

## What you bring
- At least 5 years of experience as a data engineer or senior data analyst in a consulting or enterprise setting
- Strong Python and SQL
- Hands-on experience with Azure data services (Data Factory, Synapse or Microsoft Fabric) and Databricks or Spark
- Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouses, and with data modelling
- Experience leading or mentoring engineers and managing client stakeholders
- Fluent English; we work in English every day

## Nice to have
- Terraform or other infrastructure as code
- Power BI
- Exposure to machine learning or LLM-based features in production

## Practical
We support relocation to Denmark for the right candidate. Apply by 30 November. Questions? Contact Freja Holm, Head of Data, freja.holm@nordlys-analytics.example or +45 12 34 56 78.
